purpose: preflight geometry and excitation symmetry; no FEM

octant_boundary_conditions.open_vacuum_parts_of_x0_y0_z0: homogeneous Neumann by even scalar-potential symmetry
octant_boundary_conditions.electrode_cross_sections_on_symmetry_pla: Dirichlet at that conductor terminal voltage, not Neumann
octant_boundary_conditions.individual_terminal_weighting_fields: do not reuse octant BC unless that specific excitation is proven even

interpretation: Expected exact geometric/electrical symmetry permits octant reduction for the paired RF and symmetric DC patterns. Numerical symmetry enforced on octant planes is not an accuracy check.
